sources.label: Official Lacoste GB men's size guide (Body Measurements, product-page modal)

audit: Old /gb/size-guide URL 404s; the official chart is the product-page 'Body Measurements' panel (read for every size in its selector). Old labels were one Lacoste number off: Lacoste pairs XS = 2, S = 3, M = 4 (old XS/3, S/4, M/5). Values are Lacoste's own cm figures (chest single value, waist = 'pant waist circumference', a range for S-2XL); Lacoste's inch figures beside them are ranges that don't convert exactly (e.g. S chest 93 cm vs 35-37 in), so the cm values are stored as printed. Old M chest 101 / waist 86 now M/4 = 101 / 85-89; XL 111 -> 117. Sizes 3XL-2XG (8-11) added. UK/US/EU removed (not published in the men's chart).
notes: French brand famous for the polo shirt. Uses its own numbered sizing alongside letters (XS = 2, S = 3, M = 4, L = 5, XL = 6 … up to 11). Polo shirts run slim across the shoulders.
